label: Z.ai: проверять account scope при чтении списка чатов
description: Исправить подтверждённый source defect V090: origin не доказывает неизменность аккаунта после attach. Проверять связанный account scope на результате native чтения; неизвестная identity не успешный пустой список.
acceptance: Fake direct-CDP scenario attach A→response B отвергается AccountMismatch; identity unavailable не возвращает успешный список; A сохраняет IDs. Live account switching не нужно. Scoped commit и RED/GREEN, без общих schema/Cargo edits.

changes.result: crates/herder/src/adapters/zai/mod.rs rechecks the expected account scope before list_chats. Fake-CDP proof: A→B returns AccountMismatch; A→A returns the A chat ID; unavailable identity returns AccountMismatch. RED/GREEN transcripts are in evidence/V090SCOPE-red.txt and evidence/V090SCOPE-green.txt; bug B561a6dad868b443caa3a is fixed.

progress_events.note: Delta review: attach/preflight scope checks are insufficient if account changes before list fetch. Revalidate scope from the same list response via one returned chat readback; empty/unverifiable list fails closed. Original Bcc3... remains canonical bug; B561... will be linked duplicate after correction.
The same-page scope check and its direct expression regression are complete.

changes.result: list_chats now validates the account scope proven by readback of the first chat from the same list evaluation and rejects empty/unverifiable results. Fake-CDP covers attach A + preflight A + list result B, A→A, and unavailable identity; Node VM runs the exact embedded JS expression through 7 fetch/hash scenarios. RED/GREEN: evidence/V090SCOPE-delta-red.txt and evidence/V090-V093-delta-green.txt. Canonical bug Bcc3deeef34fc45249cf8 fixed; B561a6dad868b443caa3a linked duplicate.

list_chats verifies the first returned chat belongs to the expected Z.ai account and rejects mismatched, empty, or unverifiable results. Implementation + source tests: commit 35b1337692bc0dcc7cd6c16f8d2b84d94a61fd5b. Exact embedded Rust expression executed in Node VM with stubbed fetch/hash: 7 scenarios, TAP 8 passed, 0 failed; saved output evidence/V090SCOPE-expression-green.txt (SHA-256 23e1bc2e2ab423a8a10894d6b8617d69e74f73c2c708a25e233979fa09220289). Fake-CDP regressions and Rust account-bound snapshot checks are recorded in evidence/V090SCOPE-green.txt and evidence/V090-V093-delta-green.txt. No live provider list read claimed.
